who.text: Jesus, the disciples, Peter, the crowds and Roman authorities.

where.text: Galilee, the road and Jerusalem.

when.text: Commonly dated around AD 65-70, possibly earlier.

what.text: Mark tells the fast-paced story of Jesus as the powerful Son of God who suffers, calling disciples to follow him.

before.text: Presents Jesus as the beginning of the gospel.

stakes.text: Jesus is the suffering Son of God; following him means the cross.
